story.sceneDescription: 远景固定镜头，机位略高于海面，拍摄开阔的海岸线全景。镜头极缓慢推近，海面波光粼粼，暖金色调占据画面主导；前景礁石轮廓深暗，为画面增加层次。无字幕。
story.narrative: 以开阔海岸线全景与金色光路确立全片的宁静基调

shot.focus: the shimmering golden light path on the calm sea, between dark foreground rocks and the distant horizon

storyboard.composition: dark foreground rock silhouettes frame the lower edge, calm sea and golden light path lead toward the horizon on the right third
storyboard.lighting: warm golden-hour low sunlight from the west creating a shimmering reflection path on the water, soft thin clouds catching the golden glow

calm sea with shimmering gold light path
thin layered clouds at low altitude

story.sceneDescription: 中景固定镜头，从礁石侧面贴近海面拍摄。波浪涌来撞击礁石，溅起白色水花，水珠在逆光中闪烁；镜头轻微下摇跟随水流退回，金色光斑在湿润礁石表面游动。色调开始向淡紫过渡。无字幕。
story.narrative: 用浪击礁石的鲜活细节带出动态元素与色彩过渡的起点

shot.movement: gentle tilt down tracking the retreating backwash
shot.focus: white foam and water spray bursting against the dark rock, sparkling droplets in backlight

storyboard.composition: low camera angle close to the waterline, dark rock mass on the left, churning water filling the right and foreground
storyboard.lighting: strong warm backlight from the low sun, water droplets sparkling in rim light, palette shifting from gold to soft lavender
visualElements: white sea foam and spray bursting on rock
wet dark basalt with gliding golden highlights
cooling lavender reflections on the water surface
storyboard.atmosphere: intimate close-up of nature's rhythm, authentic handheld phone texture, film-like dynamic, 8k

bgm.timing: no music; waves dominant, softer during bird calls

keyMoments.event: 波浪开始间歇撞击礁石，水花溅起
镜头轻微下摇跟随水流退回

story.sceneDescription: 中全景，镜头从礁石低角度缓慢上摇至天空。海面占据画面下半部，上半部是淡紫色云层；最后几缕暖金色光线从云隙中透出，与紫色天空交汇。海浪声变得平缓。无字幕。
story.narrative: 视线自海面抬升至紫云天空，完成暖金到淡紫的情绪转换

shot.movement: slow tilt up from the reef to the sky
shot.focus: lavender clouds with the last warm golden rays breaking through cloud gaps

storyboard.composition: horizontal split composition, calm sea in the lower half, layered lavender clouds filling the upper half, sun glow on the upper third
storyboard.lighting: last warm low-angle sunlight piercing thin cloud gaps, soft lavender-violet ambient in the upper sky, golden reflected streaks on the sea
visualElements: calm sea surface in the lower frame
final golden rays through cloud gaps

keyMoments.event: 镜头从礁石低角度开始上摇
画面切至海面与淡紫云层各半构图
云隙透出最后暖金光线，与紫空交汇

story.sceneDescription: 远景静态镜头，画面中心是平静的海面与渐暗的紫色天空。镜头极缓慢拉远，海面反光逐渐暗淡，整体色调偏淡紫与深蓝。画面保持静默，适合淡出收尾。无字幕。
story.narrative: 以渐暗的平静海面收束全片，为淡出结尾留足呼吸感
